content.text: MOA: anti-inflam via multi actions on several types of WBCs
▪︎Sarcoidosis: tx of choice (prednisone, typically up to 6mo b4 taper)
▪︎Berylliosis: symptomatic + abnl PFTs (ex, prednisone); most need lifelong low-dose
▪︎Primary AI (Addison): lifelong replacement (prednisone, hydrocortisone, dexamethasone) + mineralocorticoid (fludrocortisone)
▪︎Cushing dz postop: empiric hydrocortisone for cortisol withdrawal Sx, taper slowly
▪︎ITP: life-threatening bleed → IV methylprednisolone; ⍉rapid plt rise needed → PO dexamethasone or prednisone
▪︎GPA: systemic GC + MTX (limited dz); + cyclophosphamide (more severe dz)
